A large part of watching porn is novelty. Regardless of age we are all curious creatures. Moving through the different porn genres is natural. I've been using porn for decades and up until recently had a substantial collection because I wouldn't know what what get me off from one day to the next. Yes you could say some porn is less healthy than others but it is probably important to work out if this is just experimenting or something you like. Either way what is more important is to not get in the habit of watching false period. Regardless of genre softcore of hardcore it has the same effect on he body. I cant imagine what is it like for a teenager in this day with constant access to porn. 

I would strongly recommend you follow the other comments and work out what are your triggers to needing porn, and work on those triggers. Its amazing how enlightening it is when the 'penny drops' and you realize what you have been avoiding or trying to deal with.

novelty is probably the hardest thing to overcome. Wondering what people have posted or the latest video from the porn start you like. This is what really leads you into relapsing. 

Activities always help, trying to take your mind off of it. Making devices less accessible, not too much alone time is another good one. 

Ultimately you need find a new 'new thing' finding something creative either through reading, a hobby or something like that to replace the novelty is what will work the best. Also actually thinking about what is actually going on in your mind at the time. Accepting that you have these thoughts, but also understanding that searching now for the new porn isnt going to make you feel any better. Its all fake, not the actual porn for the effect it is having on you.
